dialog.1 Tab.name: Confirm an export
dialog.1 Tab.speech: the centre Confirmations named by their verb, a dangerous one, a form from descriptors with a path picker, a choice, a notice, a close button, movable dialogs, a clear backdrop and an error whose Copy button copies its details. Each button opens a dialog. Enter accepts (except a danger), Escape cancels. Each dialog's Copy button (its bottom left corner) copies its title and text, and its details when it has some: shown under Details on the error, hidden on the others. A movable dialog is dragged by its header band (a double click centres it); Alt+F7 moves it with the arrow keys. The levels dialog comes back where it was left. Sent by the last accepted dialog | panel | Confirm an export | button.
